result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: the Popular section header shows an unresolved localization key instead of actual text.

issues.description: Second restaurant carousel header displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper localized string, e.g. 'Popular near you', and ensure translation files contain the key for all supported locales.
